from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, current_date, md5, concat_ws, coalesce, crc32, current_timestamp, expr

# 1. Paths
target_path = "abfss://target@storageadflearntcs.dfs.core.windows.net/deltafiles/customers_delta"
source_path = "abfss://target@storageadflearntcs.dfs.core.windows.net/source/customers_scd2_test.csv" # or incremental path

# 2. Read Incremental Source & Compute Hash for Change Detection
df_source = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(source_path) \
    .withColumn("MD5_CHECKSUM", md5(concat_ws("~#~", 
        coalesce(col("FirstName"), lit("")), 
        coalesce(col("LastName"), lit("")), 
        coalesce(col("City"), lit("")), 
        coalesce(col("State"), lit("")), 
        coalesce(col("Email"), lit("")), 
        coalesce(col("PhoneNumber").cast("string"), lit(""))
    )))

# Register source as temp view
df_source.createOrReplaceTempView("stg_incoming")

# 3. Read Active Target Records
deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, target_path)
df_target = deltaTable.toDF().filter(col("IsCurrent") == 1)
df_target.createOrReplaceTempView("dim_active")

# 4. Execute Atomic SCD Type 2 Merge via Spark SQL
spark.sql("""
MERGE INTO delta.`` AS target
USING (
    -- Scenario A: Changed Records that need to be EXPIRED (Matched records)
    SELECT 
        target.CustomerSK AS merge_key,
        stg.CustomerID, stg.FirstName, stg.LastName, stg.Email, stg.City, stg.State, stg.PhoneNumber,
        stg.MD5_CHECKSUM,
        'UPDATE' AS action_type
    FROM stg_incoming stg
    JOIN dim_active target ON stg.CustomerID = target.CustomerID
    WHERE stg.MD5_CHECKSUM != target.MD5_CHECKSUM

    UNION ALL

    -- Scenario B: Brand New Customers (Unmatched records -> Insert)
    SELECT 
        NULL AS merge_key,
        stg.CustomerID, stg.FirstName, stg.LastName, stg.Email, stg.City, stg.State, stg.PhoneNumber,
        stg.MD5_CHECKSUM,
        'INSERT_NEW' AS action_type
    FROM stg_incoming stg
    LEFT ANTI JOIN dim_active target ON stg.CustomerID = target.CustomerID

    UNION ALL

    -- Scenario C: New Active Versions for Changed Records (Unmatched due to NULL merge_key -> Insert)
    SELECT 
        NULL AS merge_key,
        stg.CustomerID, stg.FirstName, stg.LastName, stg.Email, stg.City, stg.State, stg.PhoneNumber,
        stg.MD5_CHECKSUM,
        'INSERT_VERSION' AS action_type
    FROM stg_incoming stg
    JOIN dim_active target ON stg.CustomerID = target.CustomerID
    WHERE stg.MD5_CHECKSUM != target.MD5_CHECKSUM
) source
ON target.CustomerSK = source.merge_key AND target.IsCurrent = 1

-- 1. Expire existing active row
WHEN MATCHED AND source.action_type = 'UPDATE' THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.EndDate = current_date(),
        target.IsCurrent = 0

-- 2. Insert new records (Brand new + New versions)
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (CustomerSK, CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, Email, City, State, PhoneNumber, StartDate, EndDate, IsCurrent)
    VALUES (
        abs(crc32(concat(source.CustomerID, current_timestamp()))), 
        source.CustomerID, source.FirstName, source.LastName, source.Email, source.City, source.State, source.PhoneNumber,
        current_date(), 
        CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE), 
        1
    )
""".format(target_path))

print("SCD Type 2 Merge completed successfully.")
